name: Home Blessings
overview: Scripture reveals that the home is a place of beauty, peace, and divine blessing when centered on the Lord. The tents and tabernacles of Israel symbolize a dwelling pleasing to God, marked by peace within its walls and prosperity in its borders. Choosing to serve the Lord as a household, as Joshua declares, establishes a foundation of trust in God rather than in human understanding, resulting in a home filled with His finest provision and protection.
